t1.text: Reports, spread into the pages teachers already use

n0.text: The Reports menu item is REMOVED (the last "Soon" goes away). Nothing new in the menu. Groups list, Group page, Students list, Student page and Course page each gain their part. Plan & usage stays planned for Settings, after V1.

n1.text:
How the numbers are counted (V1)

Attendance: sessions the student was marked Present out of the Group's finished sessions while they were in it. Cancelled sessions and unsaved attendance don't count.

Homework done: submitted out of given (released to them, deadline in the month).

Exam average: marks out of the maximum, released results only. Absent is shown on its own, never as 0.

All counted in the Group the student was in at the time. Moving Groups never rewrites the past.

n2.text:
Needs attention (default rule)

Any of: attendance under 75%, 2 or more homework missing, exam average under 50%, or absent from an exam.

Each student shows WHY in plain words ("Missed 2 sessions"), worst first.

n3.text:
Time range

This month by default. Tap the month to pick another, or Whole course. Groups list and Students filter use this month.

n4.text:
Pace (V1 = simple)

Lessons published and homework given to that Group.

LATER (not V1): the teacher marks "today we did Lesson 5" while taking attendance, so pace is real. Needs its own decisions first.
